# Variable `SDK_DEPLOY`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

The directory set up and used by the populate_sdk_base class to which the SDK is deployed. The populate_sdk_base class defines SDK_DEPLOY as follows:

```
SDK_DEPLOY = "${TMPDIR}/deploy/sdk"

```

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/variables.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-SDK_DEPLOY)
